The earlier answer holds. I re-derived it and it is the only schedule that fits all 17 constraints.

- Ann is immediately after Ben, and Ann, Cara, Elif must be consecutive. So Ben, Ann, Cara, Elif form a run starting at Ben. Elif is Ben+3, and Dev must come after Elif, so Ben ≤ 5.
- Finn, Gus, Hana and Ivo all come before Ben, so Ben ≥ 5. That forces Ben=5, Ann=6, Cara=7, Elif=8, Dev=9.
- Ann–Hana are at least 3 apart, so Hana ≤ 3. Hana is immediately after Ivo, so Hana is 2 or 3.
- Finn–Gus are at least 3 apart within slots 1–4, so {Finn, Gus} = {1, 4}. Ivo is before Gus, so Gus can't be 1. Gus=4 and Finn=1.
- That leaves Ivo=2 and Hana=3.

I checked every constraint against this arrangement: Finn before Ben, Elif before Dev, Ann right after Ben, Ivo before Gus, Finn before Ann, Cara–Gus gap 3, Hana before Ben, Elif right after Cara, Gus before Ben, Elif–Ivo gap 6, Hana right after Ivo, Finn–Gus gap 3, Finn before Hana, one person (Cara) between Ann and Elif, Dev–Finn gap 8, Ann before Cara, and Ann–Hana gap 3. All hold.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ivo","3":"Hana","4":"Gus","5":"Ben","6":"Ann","7":"Cara","8":"Elif","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
